items.author: N/A
items.highlights: ### NVIDIA Is Increasing Its Supply Commitments Perhaps the clearest supply-chain signal in the report was the sharp increase in NVIDIA's future supply and capacity commitments. As of July 26, NVIDIA had $279 billion of supply and capacity commitments, compared with $119 billion three months earlier. The increase was primarily related to memory procurement, reflecting the company's efforts to secure critical components and manufacturing capacity ahead of expected demand.
